results.title: Seales takes five as West Indies beat Pakistan by 90 runs
results.description: Chasing 211 after West Indies were bowled out for 181 in their second innings, Pakistan collapsed to 71-9 before Babar and Abbas delayed the inevitable with a stubborn partnership.

results.title: IPL's business value soars above $20 billion, says report
results.description: The business value of the Indian Premier League, the world's richest Twenty20 series, has soared more than 11% to $20.6 billion this year, according to U.S.-based investment bank Houlihan Lokey.

results.title: Watford unveil away kit with classic red and black stripes
results.description: Watford have unveiled their away kit - a red-and-black striped 'AC Milan' look that is a throwback to the shirt worn in the 1997/98 and 2010/11 seasons.
